regime_context: Leadership is narrow (only 4 of 22 themes eligible, 18% breadth) and the one verified edge — the absolute-trend gate — did_NOT_hold on China A-shares history, so this detector is display-only here. Banks lead by a hair over Innovative Pharma & CXO, with both crowded; the tape mean-reverts against trend discipline, so I lean low and treat every call as a conditional, not a forecast.
emerging_watch: Watch whether rotation breadth widens from 18% toward 30%+ and the Banks-Pharma margin widens beyond 0.05 in either direction before the next check — that would confirm whether leadership is consolidating into Banks or handing off to Pharma; the watch retires if the margin stays under 0.05 for 10 straight sessions.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is the challenger one step behind Banks with strength (0.988) and adequate durability (0.60), and — unlike Banks — it is not yet the top crowd, so it carries less reflexive downside from a crowding flag even though its own crowding_z is high. In a narrow tape where the gate does not help, I would rather lean on the challenger with breadth (0.643) than chase the fully-crowded leader.
evidence: crowding_z 1.59 (crowded) but not the #1 crowding flag
rotation shows Pharma as challenger with a razor-thin 0.01 margin to Banks
theses.dissent: Both top themes are crowded and the rotation margin is negligible; in a mean-reverting tape that whipsaws the trend gate, the challenger could stall just as easily as it rotates through.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags 512800.SS by 6% or more over any 10-session stretch before the 20-day check horizon

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed leader (0.998) with the highest durability (0.73) and strongest breadth (0.889). On a mean-reverting tape the leader is the most likely to retain focus short-term even if the trend gate offers no drawdown shield. The crowding flag (z=1.78, crowded=True) is a cap, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowded and top-of-scale; in a narrow, mean-reverting regime where trend discipline whipsaws, the fully-crowded leader is the most fragile to a shake-out, so the overweight conviction must be kept at the floor.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS loses relative strength to 159992.SZ by 5% or more before the 15-day check horizon

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible theme tagged mean-revert (hurst_tag) with a mediocre durability bar (0.46) and thin breadth (0.30). Its momentum score (0.495) is middle-of-pack, and the trend gate does not hold here, so a mean-reverting leader with weak breadth is structurally the least suited to a trend-following lean.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert regimes can produce sharp dead-cat reversals, and Coal is not crowded, so an 'avoid' could miss a bounce if the tape snaps back.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS outperforms 512800.SS by 5% or more over any 10-session stretch before the 20-day check horizon
